articles.title: Ripple raises $275 million in senior notes for prime brokerage push
articles.snippet: Ripple Prime's inaugural senior notes carried an investment grade rating and drew institutional investors across key financial markets.

articles.title: Ripple raises $275M for US prime brokerage to meet institutional demand
articles.snippet: Ripple said the $275 million raised will support its expansion into traditional financial services such as prime brokerage and multi-asset clearing, citing strong demand from institutions.
